neighbours.label: 'zone' and similar nouns for a spatial band or belt of a region (zone, band, belt), esp. in geoscience
fire: Earthquakes cluster along a narrow zone where the plates meet.
The frontal zone moved south overnight, bringing cold rain.
Farmers in the transition zone grow both maize and millet.
A belt of volcanoes runs along the edge of the ocean basin.
Satellite images show a band of clouds stretching for miles.
The Sahel is a semi-arid zone south of the Sahara desert.
Fault rocks form a thick zone of crushed stone along the fracture.
The deep ocean has a dark zone where no sunlight reaches.
quiet: Earthquakes are common where the plates of the crust meet.
The cold front moved south overnight, bringing cold rain.
Farmers in the northern villages grow both maize and millet.
Several volcanoes rise along the edge of the ocean basin.
Satellite images show clouds stretching for many miles.
The Sahel lies south of the Sahara and is semi-arid.
Fault rocks are crushed into small stones along the fracture.
The deep ocean is dark because no sunlight reaches it.
